title: Longest Increasing Subsequence
hints: The O(n^2) DP: dp[i] = 1 + max(dp[j] for j < i if nums[j] < nums[i]). Get that working first; it is what most candidates are expected to reach quickly.
For O(n log n) keep tails[k] = the smallest value that can end an increasing subsequence of length k + 1. Why does tails stay sorted as you process the numbers?
For each x, binary-search the first tails entry >= x (bisect_left) and overwrite it; if there is none, append. len(tails) is the answer. Strictly increasing means bisect_left, not bisect_right.
